name: Uptonica – AI assistant, forms and marketing
author: uptonica

sections.description:
Uptonica is an AI marketing platform: a CRM with email and WhatsApp automations, forms and popups, an AI assistant that answers your visitors, and, for online stores, product content and advertising reports.

This plugin connects your site to your Uptonica workspace without copying keys or code by hand. It works on any WordPress site; on a WooCommerce store it also connects the store.

On every site

  • One-click connection. Click «Connect to Uptonica» and choose your workspace.
  • Your forms become contacts. What people send through Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms or Elementor Pro forms also reaches your Uptonica CRM: each submission with an email becomes a contact, shows in «Lead sources» and can start your automations. Your forms keep working as before.
  • Uptonica forms and popups in your pages. Add the «Uptonica form» block, or the [uptonica_form id="…"] shortcode, to show a form or popup made in Uptonica.
  • Leads counted from the server. A form submission reaches Meta as a lead, from your server, only when the visitor accepted marketing cookies, so a blocked browser script does not lose it.
  • Registrations as contacts. Optionally, people who register on your site join your CRM (without marketing consent).
  • The assistant with a switch. Add the Uptonica code to every page without editing your theme or Tag Manager. What it shows (the assistant, visit measurement) is chosen in Uptonica.

On a WooCommerce store, also

  • Store connection. Approve access on the standard WooCommerce screen: your catalog, orders and customers stay in sync.
  • Store updates that keep arriving. WooCommerce switches a webhook off after a few failed deliveries and drops the failed ones. For Uptonica’s webhooks, the plugin sends failed deliveries again later and switches them back on.
  • Purchases from the server. A purchase is counted even when the shopper pays on an external page and never returns to the thank-you page, or blocks scripts. It is sent only when the shopper accepted measurement in your cookie banner.

Requirements

  • An Uptonica account. You can create one during the connection.
  • For the store features: WooCommerce 8.0 or later and a site served over https (WooCommerce’s approval screen requires it).

External services

This plugin connects to Uptonica (https://uptonica.com/), a service run by the plugin’s author. Without it the plugin does nothing.

  • When you click «Connect to Uptonica», your browser is sent to app.uptonica.com with your site address, the address of the plugin page and whether WooCommerce is active. On a store, after you approve on the WooCommerce screen, WooCommerce sends Uptonica a REST API key for your store. Then the plugin calls https://app.uptonica.com/api/wordpress/v1/exchange once, from your server, to learn which workspace it joined and receive the key of your site’s lead source.
  • When «Send what people submit through your forms» is on, each submission with an email is sent from your server to your lead source at https://app.uptonica.com/api/crm/forms/intake/…: the fields the person filled in, the form’s name, their IP address and browser user agent, the Uptonica visitor id (_uton_aid) when they accepted measurement, and the Meta click id from _fbc when they accepted marketing.
  • When «Add people who register on this site» is on, each new account’s email and name are sent the same way.
  • In the block editor, the «Uptonica form» block reads the list of your workspace’s forms from https://app.uptonica.com/api/wordpress/v1/forms. A page with the block or shortcode loads the form from https://app.uptonica.com/f/…, and the visitor’s browser then talks to app.uptonica.com.
  • When «Add the Uptonica code to every page» is on, every page loads https://app.uptonica.com/widget/uptonica.js. It shows the AI assistant and, following your cookie banner, measures visits.
  • When «Send purchases from the server» is on (stores only), each paid order whose shopper accepted measurement is sent from your server to https://app.uptonica.com/api/events: order number, total, currency, products, the shopper’s email (used to match the purchase to an existing contact and not stored on the event), IP address and browser user agent, and the analytics cookies already on the shopper’s device (_uton_aid, _ga, _fbp, _fbc).
  • Store updates are sent by WooCommerce’s own webhooks, which Uptonica registers on your store during the connection.

Uptonica terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate this plugin.
  2. Open the Uptonica page (in the admin menu, or under WooCommerce on a store) and click «Connect to Uptonica».
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Without WooCommerce you get the forms, the registrations, the Uptonica code and the block. WooCommerce adds the store connection, its updates and purchases.

Does the plugin store my API keys?

No WooCommerce key: WooCommerce creates it on its approval screen and sends it to Uptonica directly. The plugin stores the workspace name, the public code of your Uptonica site tag and the key of your site’s lead source, which it never prints in a page.

Which form plugins are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms and Elementor Pro forms. A submission without an email address is not sent.

How do I disconnect?

Uptonica → Disconnect. On a store it also deletes the API key and the webhooks Uptonica was given. Your pages lose the Uptonica code and forms, and submissions stop being sent.

Which cookie banners are supported?

Any banner that implements the WP Consent API, plus Complianz, CookieYes, Cookiebot, OneTrust and iubenda. With any other banner, a purchase is sent only if the Uptonica code had already been allowed to measure that visitor, and a form submission still becomes a contact but never reaches Meta.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Works on any WordPress site, with or without WooCommerce.
  • Submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms and Elementor Pro become contacts in Uptonica, and leads for Meta with the visitor’s consent.
  • «Uptonica form» block and [uptonica_form] shortcode for Uptonica forms and popups.
  • Optional: people who register on the site become contacts.

1.0.1

  • Webhook retries: one waits per product or order however many deliveries failed, Uptonica’s Retry-After is honoured, and retries are spread out so a bulk import does not come back all at once.

1.0.0

  • First release: one-click connection, site tag switch, webhook retries, purchases sent from the server.
